additional_info.subject: RES: RES: ID0413253-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197006] Requested for firmware upgrade CRM:00641001220
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Below the answers:
The current version is
v5.0.23
. Please let us know when we can plan the upgrade so that we can inform our team accordingly.
A: What we would like is to schedule from 00:00 to 07:00 (Brazil time).
Is it possible?
Also, regarding your question, are you referring to the
countdown in seconds
before the idle screen is displayed?
A: No, it would enable an ultra-low power mode in standby.
This would be a "power savings" mode that leaves it in low power mode, waiting for the customer to touch the screen to turn it on.
Best Regards,
João Paulo de Camargo Torres Pinto
